column2: permcount[v_] := Module[{m = 1, s = 0, k = 0, t}, For[i = 1, i <= Length[v], i++, t = v[[i]]; k = If[i > 1 && t == v[[i - 1]], k + 1, 1]; m *= t*k; s += t]; s!/m];
edges[v_] := 4 Sum[Sum[GCD[v[[i]], v[[j]]], {j, 1, i - 1}], {i, 2, Length[v]}] + 2 Total[v];
